usageNotes: Retrieves the full configuration of a single route map entry identified by its zero-based order index, including its action (permit/deny), match conditions, set actions, and exit-action flow control. Use this before updating or deleting an entry to capture the current digest for optimistic concurrency protection. Requires SDN.Audit or SDN.Allocate on the route-map path; SDN must be enabled on the cluster.

examples.summary: Fetch entry at order 10 from route map 'bgp-out'

tips: The 'order' value is the sequence index (0–65535), not a line number — gaps between entries are intentional and used for inserting new entries between existing ones.
Capture the returned 'digest' field and pass it to update/delete calls to prevent overwriting concurrent changes.
The 'call' field, if present, indicates this entry delegates control to another route map — follow that map's entries to understand the full policy chain.
exit-action values: 'on-match-goto <order>' jumps to a specific entry, 'on-match-next' continues to the next sequential entry, 'continue' evaluates the next entry regardless of match.
